brief_summary: This is the phase 3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical study to evaluate the efficacy and long-term safety of SAL067 in T2DM patients uncontrolled by metformin, comprising 24 weeks of double-blind treatment period followed by an open-label treatment period, making up a total of 52 weeks.
brief_title: SAL067 Treatment in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Who Are Not Controlled by Metformin
official_title: A Multi-center, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo Parallel Controlled Phase III Clinical Trial for the Efficacy and Safety of Fugliglitinate Benzoate Tablets in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Who Cannot be Effectively Controlled by Metformin

primary_outcomes.measure: HbA1c change from baseline at week 24
